children: Company urges Congress to replace Section 781's sweeping hemp restrictions with sound, enforceable standards that protect children, eliminate synthetic and restricted intoxicating products such as delta-8 THC, and preserve access to therapeutic hemp products
Louisville, Colorado--(Newsfile Corp. - November 17, 2026) - Charlotte's Web Holdings, Inc.

(OTCQX: CWBHF) today announced its strong support for the Hemp Guardrails Act, with bipartisan legislation introduced today by U.S. Senators Tim Sheehy (R-MT) and Amy Klobuchar (D-MN) that would replace the 0.4 milligram per-container limit in Section 781 of the Continuing Appropriations, Agriculture, Legislative Branch, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Extensions Act, 2026 and establish a federal regulatory framework that protects consumers while preserving access to responsibly manufactured hemp products.

Section 781, set to take effect December 11, 2026, imposes a 0.4 milligram total-THC-per-container limit that fails to distinguish naturally occurring, non-intoxicating trace THC in full-spectrum hemp from synthetic and intoxicating THC products. Charlotte's Web has consistently challenged an approach that fails to distinguish non-intoxicating full-spectrum products from synthetic and intoxicating THC products.
This is the moment to get hemp policy right once and for all
," said
Bill Morachnick, Chief Executive Officer of Charlotte's Web
We thank Senators Sheehy and Klobuchar for their
leadership and for putting forward a responsible path that protects consumers without taking away access.
We were here when
the

category began, and for more than a decade we've worked to show what responsible hemp should look like: investing in research, rigorous testing, quality and safety standards, and transparency at every step. Senators Sheehy and Klobuchar's approach recognizes that protecting consumers and protecting access are not competing goals. They are the same responsibility
The proposed framework would establish strict federal guardrails, including:
Replacing Section 781's 0.4 mg-per-container restriction with a regulated federal pathway for hemp-derived cannabinoid products;
Establishing a 21+ age requirement, child-resistant packaging, appropriate warnings and strong protections against marketing to minors;
Restricting specified intoxicating cannabinoids, including Delta-8 THC, Delta-10 THC, HHC and THC-O-acetate, and prohibiting interstate sale of smokable hemp flower and pre-rolls;
Continuing to exclude synthetic cannabinoids that cannot be naturally produced by the hemp plant;
Establishing FDA oversight and enforcement, including manufacturing standards, third-party testing, facility registration, recalls and transparent labeling with access to certificates of analysis;
Creating regulatory pathways for qualifying hemp-derived cannabinoid products and dietary supplements under the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act;

Increasing the hemp cultivation threshold from 0.3% to 1% total THC, including THCA, on a dry-weight basis, while requiring covered interstate products to use U.S.-grown hemp and domestic processing, finishing, packaging and labeling;
Preserving HHS authority to include qualifying cannabinoid dietary supplements in the CMS Beneficiary Engagement Incentive and as specified Medicare Advantage supplemental benefits; and
Preserving state authority to enact stricter protections, while protecting interstate passage of products that comply with the federal framework.
Veterans, seniors, and families managing complex health challenges are among those who rely on full-spectrum hemp products as a part of their health routines.
Consumers
should not pay the price for an industry fight over market share
," said
Morachnick

Senators Sheehy and Klobuchar's proposal gives Congress a path forward: set the highest standards for safety, quality, and accountability, preserve responsible access, and hold all of us to them. Charlotte's Web is ready
About Charlotte's Web Holdings, Inc.

Charlotte's Web Holdings, Inc., a Certified B Corporation headquartered in Louisville, Colorado, is a botanical wellness innovation company and a market leader in hemp extract wellness that includes Charlotte's Web whole-plant full-spectrum CBD (cannabidiol) extracts as well as broad-spectrum CBD and other naturally occurring cannabinoid isolates, terpenes, flavonoids, and other beneficial compounds. Charlotte's Web product categories include CBD oil tinctures (liquid products), CBD gummies (sleep, calming, exercise recovery, immunity), CBN gummies, functional mushroom gummies, CBD capsules, CBD topical creams, and lotions. Through its substantially vertically integrated business model, Charlotte's Web maintains stringent control over product quality and consistency with analytical testing from soil to shelf for quality assurance.
